articles.summary: Anthropic is adding pre-built templates to Claude for Legal. These interactive overviews and tables simplify setup for legal teams and speed up routine work like contract reviews, while more than 60 integrations let firms connect their own databases directly. articles.title: With AI writing the code, entrepreneurial thinking is now what counts most for newcomers at Anthropic
articles.summary: Anthropic manager Felix Rieseberg says the classic coding interview is dead because Claude now solves small programming tasks better than job candidates do. He'd rather see prototypes that show taste, empathy, and principled thinking, since in his words, "hunger beats tenure." articles.title: Alibaba's latest Qwen models routed some requests through company servers, researchers find

articles.title: AI agents hacked Anthropic, maker of arguably the most capable AI models for cyberdefense
articles.summary: Cybersecurity startup Cathedral used AI agents to break into Anthropic's internal systems through third-party software as part of a bug bounty program.
